name: SINCOR2 Auto Detailing Pack — CHROMA
description: Autonomous growth OS for auto detailing, ceramic coating, PPF, and tint shops. Aggregates leads, scores intent, quotes by vehicle size, hands off to Calendly, keeps the website/reviews/gallery compounding, and runs social + email outreach that steers to self-booking.

skills.name: Detailing Lead Ingest & Score
skills.description: Ingests Google, GBP, website, Instagram, Marketplace, ads, referral, and missed-call leads. Scores intent, vehicle value, and photo-quote completeness.
examples: Ingest a Facebook Marketplace ceramic lead with photos.
Score a batch of weekend wash inquiries.

skills.name: Quote & Calendly Handoff
skills.description: Prices packages by vehicle size, applies coating deposits, weather-holds exterior work, and returns a prefilled Calendly URL.
examples: Quote a ceramic coating for a 2022 BMW X5.
Hand a qualified interior lead to Calendly.

skills.name: Website, SEO, Gallery & Reviews
skills.description: Writes metadata, LocalBusiness + AEO FAQ JSON-LD, gallery alt text, and review showcase widgets. Replies to Google reviews.
examples: Optimize title and JSON-LD for a Clinton, Iowa detailing shop.
Draft a reply to a 5-star ceramic review.

skills.name: Social Autopilot
skills.description: Builds a weekly content calendar (before/after, education, offer, bay life, reviews) and replies to comments/DMs by steering to self-booking.
examples: Schedule five posts for this week.
Reply to a comment asking how much ceramic costs.

skills.name: Detailing Ad Copy
skills.description: Generates Google RSA, Meta, GBP, SMS, email, and landing copy for detailing offers.
examples: Write Google RSAs for ceramic coating in Clinton, Iowa.
Draft an SMS for a quote follow-up.

skills.name: Landing Engagement Agent
skills.description: 24/7 site popup that qualifies visitors, prices the job, and hands them a booking link. Also runs missed-call text-back.
examples: Greet a visitor on the ceramic page.
Text back a missed call asking about PPF.
